abort.already_configured: This Print Handy Web UI is already configured
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Print Handy connection was updated

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Print Handy Web UI. Check the address and that the Web UI is enabled.
error.invalid_auth: The Web UI rejected the credential. Enter the Web UI access token or the Web UI password.
error.invalid_url: Enter the Web UI address of your Print Handy instance.
error.forbidden_host: Print Handy refused the request because of the address used. With no Web UI password it only answers by IP address or a local host name (a single word, or ending in .local, .lan, .home, .internal or .home.arpa). Use the server's IP address, or set a Web UI password in Print Handy and enter it as the token.
error.rate_limited: Print Handy is temporarily rejecting requests from Home Assistant after failed attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.server_error: Print Handy answered with a server error. Check its logs and try again.
error.url_in_use: Another Print Handy entry already uses this address.
error.wrong_server: That address answers as a different Print Handy instance. Add it as a new entry instead.
error.unknown: Print Handy answered, but not with a usable status snapshot.

user.title: Connect to Print Handy
user.description: Connect to the Print Handy instance that manages your printers. Its Web UI must be enabled. Example address: {example_url}

data.token: Access token or Web UI password (optional)

data_description.url: Use the server's IP address or a local host name. With no Web UI password set, Print Handy refuses requests that use a public-looking host name.
data_description.token: Either the Web UI access token (the WEBUI_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable on the Print Handy side) or the Web UI password. Leave it empty when the Web UI has no password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Print Handy
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credential no longer works for {url}. Enter the current Web UI access token or Web UI password. Leave it empty if the Web UI no longer has a password.

data.token: Access token or Web UI password (optional)

reconfigure.title: Change the Print Handy connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address or credential. Entities and history are kept.

data.token: Access token or Web UI password (optional)

data_description.url: Use the server's IP address or a local host name.
data_description.token: Either the Web UI access token or the Web UI password. Leave it empty when the Web UI has no password.

data_description.scan_interval: How often each printer's live status is read. Cheap; the default is 30 seconds.
data_description.hub_scan_interval: How often the printer roster, version and health are read. This makes Print Handy run its full self-check, so keep it slow; the default is 300 seconds.
